records.jp: どうも
records.en_original: Hello.
records.en: Hello.

records.jp: ライムさんの様子はどう？
records.en_original: How's Lime holding up?
records.en: How's Lime-san holding up?

records.jp: 変わりない
records.en_original: The same.
records.en: The same.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: 良くもなっていないから、このままだと少しずつ<CR>すり減っていく
records.en_original: She's not getting any better, so she'll run out of energy if things carry on like this.
records.en: She's not getting any better, so she'll run out of energy if things carry on like this.

records.jp: 急がないとね
records.en_original: We'd better hurry, then.
records.en: We'd better hurry, then.

records.jp: 何か聞きたいこととかある？
records.en_original: Was there something you wanted to ask me?
records.en: Was there something you wanted to ask me?

records.jp: モンスターって何なの？<CR>リフナビは心の歪みの具現化だーって言ってたけど
records.en_original: What exactly are demons? ReSource said they're physical embodiments of emotional distress, but...
records.en: What exactly are demons? ReSource said they're physical embodiments of emotional distress, but...

records.jp: 間違ってはいない
records.en_original: That's correct.
records.en: That's correct.

records.jp: ココロトープにあるものは、すべてのその場所の<CR>元となったフラグメントの持ち主の心の現れ
records.en_original: All things inside a Heartscape come from the owner of the Fragment it was created from.
records.en: All things inside a Heartscape come from the owner of the Fragment it was created from.

records.jp: その中でも、人に見られたくない想い……負の感情は、<CR>それ自身が攻撃性をもって他者を遠ざけようとする
records.en_original: That includes the feelings they'd rather you didn't see... Those negative emotions try to keep others away—violently, if necessary.
records.en: That includes the feelings they'd rather you didn't see... Those negative emotions try to keep others away—violently, if necessary.

records.jp: それがモンスター
records.en_original: That is what demons are.
records.en: That is what demons are.

records.jp: 倒しちゃって大丈夫なの？<CR>心に影響したり……
records.en_original: Is it really okay for us to fight them, then? Won't that affect the person whose heart they're from?
records.en: Is it really okay for us to fight them, then? Won't that affect the person whose heart they're from?

records.jp: 大丈夫。たとえココロトープが壊れたとしても、<CR>フラグメントには影響しない
records.en_original: It's fine. Even if the Heartscape was destroyed, it would have no effect on the Fragment itself.
records.en: It's fine. Even if the Heartscape was destroyed, it would have no effect on the Fragment itself.

records.jp: 逆にフラグメントに……誰かの想いに変化があったら、<CR>ココロトープに影響が出るけど
records.en_original: On the contrary, a Fragment can affect the Heartscape greatly. If someone's feelings change, so will their Heartscape.
records.en: On the contrary, a Fragment can affect the Heartscape greatly. If someone's feelings change, so will their Heartscape.

records.jp: フラグメントの前にいるデカイヤツも<CR>負の感情の具現化なの？
records.en_original: Are those big things in front of the Fragments also born from negative emotions?
records.en: Are those big things in front of the Fragments also born from negative emotions?

records.jp: あれはどちらかというと、私たちが用意した存在
records.en_original: Those were put there by us.
records.en: Those were put there by us.

records.jp: え？　どういうこと？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean?

records.jp: フラグメントを危険にさらすわけにはいかない
records.en_original: We cannot allow the Fragments to be put in harm's way.
records.en: We cannot allow the Fragments to be put in harm's way.

records.jp: だから、強力なモンスターで守るよう<CR>この世界は設計されているの
records.en_original: So we designed this world to protect them using powerful demons.
records.en: So we designed this world to protect them using powerful demons.

records.jp: ユズさんの力で、あいつらはなんとかなったり……
records.en_original: You can control them with your powers...?
records.en: Could you do something about them with your powers, Yuzu-san...?

records.jp: （自分でもどうにもできないのね）
records.en_original: (I feel pretty useless by comparison.)
records.en: (I feel pretty useless by comparison.)

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: 詩帆さんから灰病については聞いてたけど、<CR>まさかこんな身近に灰病だった人がいたなんて
records.en_original: Shiho told me about Ash Syndrome, but I can't believe someone we know actually got infected.
records.en: Shiho-san told me about Ash Syndrome, but I can't believe someone we know actually got infected.

records.jp: まあでも、どうやら治る病気みたいだし。<CR>そんなに怖いものじゃないのかも
records.en_original: But I guess it isn't that scary, since it seems curable and all.
records.en: But I guess it isn't that scary, since it seems curable and all.

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 灰病って、治せるものだったかなって。<CR>そんな記憶、私にはないから
records.en_original: I don't remember anything about a cure for Ash Syndrome.
records.en: I don't remember anything about a cure for Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: 今の勇希が元気なのがその証拠だよ。<CR>治ってなきゃおかしいもん
records.en_original: Yuki being alive and well is proof enough, right? It'd be strange if there wasn't a cure.
records.en: Yuki being alive and well is proof enough, right? It'd be strange if there wasn't a cure.

records.jp: ……そうだね
records.en_original: ...I suppose so.
records.en: ...I suppose so.

records.jp: にしても、みんな灰を知ってるんだなあ。<CR>私のいた世界にはそんなものなかったのに
records.en_original: Also, everyone here seems to know about the Ash, but I never heard about it in my world.
records.en: Also, everyone here seems to know about the Ash, but I never heard about it in my world.

records.jp: 私だけ、違う世界から来たのかな……
records.en_original: Could that mean I'm the only one who came from a different world?
records.en: Could that mean I'm the only one who came from a different world?

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: みんなとは仲良くやってる？
records.en_original: Are you getting along with the others?
records.en: Are you getting along with the others?

records.jp: それなりに
records.en_original: In a sense.
records.en: In a sense.

records.jp: いっつも一人でいるから心配だよ
records.en_original: You're always by yourself, so I'm a little worried, you know.
records.en: You're always by yourself, so I'm a little worried, you know.

records.jp: そんなに話すこともないし、<CR>私がいても邪魔でしょ
records.en_original: I don't have much to talk about. I'd only get in the way.
records.en: I don't have much to talk about. I'd only get in the way.

records.jp: だからってご飯をこっそり持って行かないで。<CR>詩帆さん悲しんでたよ
records.en_original: Well, you've at least gotta stop sneaking food out! You'll make Shiho all sad.
records.en: Well, you've at least gotta stop sneaking food out! You'll make Shiho-san all sad.

records.jp: 詩帆さん、ちゃんとユズさんの分も<CR>毎日用意してるんだから
records.en_original: She always makes a portion for you too.
records.en: Shiho-san makes a portion for you every day too, Yuzu-san.

records.jp: せめて食事ぐらいは一緒に。<CR>ね？
records.en_original: So you should at least join us for meals. Okay?
records.en: So you should at least join us for meals. Okay?

records.jp: ……検討する
records.en_original: ...I'll think about it.
records.en: ...I'll think about it.

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ううん、大丈夫。<CR>それじゃあ、またね
records.en_original: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
